name: Baked Moong Dal Kachori
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: Dough: ½ cup whole-wheat flour, 1 tsp oil, pinch of salt, water to bind
Filling: ½ cup (100 g) split yellow moong dal, soaked 2 hours and coarsely ground
½ tsp each fennel seeds, cumin and coriander powder
½ tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, pinch of hing
steps: Knead the flour with oil, salt and water into a firm dough. Rest for 20 minutes.
Heat 1 tsp oil, toast the fennel and cumin, then add the ground dal, spices and salt. Cook for 6 minutes until dry; add the lemon juice and cool.
Divide the dough into 6 balls, flatten each, fill with a spoon of the dal mixture and seal.
Flatten gently, place on a lined tray and brush with oil.
Bake at 190°C for 25–30 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
note: A classic Rajasthani and Uttar Pradesh snack that is traditionally deep-fried.
